subtitle: i think i found something

name: RC Flashlight
subtitle: never leave home without one
rules: This card cannot be blocked. -- This card can block COVERT parties.

name: Ferret Oil Coating
subtitle: it's... sticky...
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- Anything that can pick the attached character must pick it. -- FLIP UP – 1 [D][D]

name: Thabbashite Organist
subtitle: the living gods call for melody
rules: When a card that provides at least [V] enters play under your control, reduce the numeric cost of the next card you play this turn by 1.
flavor: This odd gargantuan relic is actually alive. Nature in Luridia is not without its bizarre tendencies evidenced in this case by the instrumental biology of this unmoving creature.

name: Unstable Modification
subtitle: the leg-bone is connected to the... hip-bone?
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER (put this card into play attached to that character instead of into its owner's discard pile) -- At the start of your turn, choose one of the following as this card's rules text until the start of your next turn: -- OPTION 1 -- The attached character gains 1 strength. -- OPTION 2 -- The attached character gains 1 life. -- OPTION 3 -- The attached character can block COVERT parties.
notes: Footer also prints 'Original Open R&D Concept by Bizze'.
